help.body:
Tasks you need to act on this week.

• Priority: click # in order — 1, 2, 3… (within current filter)
• Capacity: hours × business days × rate
• Chart baseline: the 'My tasks' hours from the header
• Delayed: click the red badge → +1d / +1w / Today to update instantly
help.cuePrefill: Tell me how priority, capacity, and the chart work in Q task

step2.title: Set priority
